pipeline_name: MK43 Ultra Phase 3-Ready Recursive Continuity Pipeline

base_pipeline.name: MK43 Ultra Enhanced Recursive Continuity Pipeline
base_pipeline.inheritance: v0.3 preserves the v0.2 T4-T6 environmental upgrade and extends it toward sustained dynamic equilibrium and coupling-readiness.

core_architecture.phase3_goal: Prepare a single stable atomic-profile manifold, currently hydrogen-class, for future manifold-to-manifold interaction without altering the manifold itself.
core_architecture.non_negotiable_rule: The hydrogen manifold is not modified to fit the pipeline. The environment is upgraded so the manifold can travel, react, redistribute, and recover.

phase_status.phase_1: complete: topology-class preservation and oscillatory reconstruction
phase_status.phase_2: active / late-alpha: dynamic redistribution inside a stable manifold
phase_status.phase_3: prepared but not yet entered: interaction coupling laws require at least two manifolds

phase3_readiness_requirements: Sustained shell redistribution across multiple internal cycles without topology collapse.
Dynamic equilibrium formation under environmental pressure.
Persistent chirality flow or chirality tension balancing.
Core persistence remains stable while shell occupancy redistributes.
Closure topology compensates without erasing shell differentiation.
Hydrogen-class identity remains recoverable after T7→T0→T7 oscillation.
Coupling interface is exposed but not yet used for another manifold.

T0.name: chirality memory substrate domain
T0.failure_condition: T0 becomes uniform admissibility with no recoverable topology bias.

T1.name: chirality admissibility amplification domain
T1.phase3_role: amplifies latent T0 chirality memory without creating matter
T1.failure_condition: T1 generates premature persistence instead of chirality admissibility.

T2.name: adjacency geometry routing domain
T2.phase3_role: converts chirality admissibility into navigable recursive geometry
T2.failure_condition: Adjacency becomes global blur or loses local differentiation.

T3.name: propagation topology reinforcement domain
T3.phase3_role: reinforces traversable continuity pathways before persistence is allowed
T3.failure_condition: Propagation fragments prior topology or forces premature knot stabilization.

T4.name: knot-admissibility / weak persistence asymmetry domain
T4.phase3_role: particle-equivalent ER foam knot admissibility begins; localized persistence can separate from background resolution
T4.english_translation: inheritance stabilizes into bounded closure; particle-equivalent knot identity becomes admissible.
T4.failure_condition: Persistence either fails to separate from background or over-localizes into hard collapse.

T5.name: bounded shell redistribution / proto-material dynamic domain
T5.phase3_role: shell occupancy becomes the primary motion layer while core persistence resists collapse
T5.english_translation: propagation redistributes through shell occupancy while bounded closure prevents identity loss.
T5.failure_condition: Shell motion collapses into core, dissipates into blur, or loses recoverable topology class.

T6.name: dynamic continuity ecology / coupling-preparation domain
T6.phase3_role: internal dynamics stabilize enough to expose a future manifold-coupling interface
T6.english_translation: inherited topology stabilizes, closes, normalizes, and exposes interaction-readiness without losing identity.
T6.failure_condition: Interaction ecology destroys shell distinction, corrupts closure, or destabilizes core persistence.

T7.name: atomic closure equilibrium / coupling-ready writeout domain
T7.phase3_role: stable atomic-profile closure with measurable dynamic history preserved
T7.failure_condition: T7 cannot write out a stable hydrogen-class topology after dynamic traversal.

coupling_interface.purpose: Prepare for Phase 3 without actually coupling to a second manifold.
coupling_interface.current_rule: For single-manifold hydrogen tests, coupling_interface_exposure must not alter identity; it only verifies readiness.

phase2_to_phase3_tests.phase3_readiness_threshold: Correlation remains high while T4-T6 diagnostics show nonzero dynamic redistribution.
Identity remains recoverable across repeated environmental cycling.

audit_requirements: Measure shell occupancy difference pre/post traversal.
Measure T6 continuity current / circulation indicator.
Confirm core persistence did not collapse.
Confirm shell did not flatten into global blur.
